title: VoltEdge: smart grids & renewable energy
excerpt: Prof. Janaka Ekanayake on integrating renewables into smart-grid technologies — a WIE × PES lecture.
content:
In collaboration with the IEEE PES Student Chapter, IEEE WIE hosted VoltEdge — an insightful lecture on smart grids and renewable energy conducted by Prof. Janaka Ekanayake.

The session showcased transformative advances in energy systems, emphasising the integration of renewable energy into smart-grid technologies to drive sustainability and efficiency.
